channels.name: YouTube Automation Channel 1
channels.topic_prompt: Generate wholesome, visual, viral YouTube Shorts topics. Avoid dangerous, sad, or medical themes. Prefer simple stories that can be shown with stock footage.
channels.script_prompt: Write a concise 35-55 second YouTube Shorts narration. Hook in the first 3 seconds, keep sentences short and visual, and end with a soft curiosity loop.
